p1: I am Katerina Gerasimovska, founder and owner of Kingdom of Snowstorm, an FCI-registered Bichon Frisé kennel based in Skopje, North Macedonia.
p2: The story of Kingdom of Snowstorm began in 2016, with a little white Bichon Frisé named Hannah who came into my life and changed it in a way I could have never imagined. She was not only my first Bichon — she was the beginning of a beautiful connection with this wonderful breed and the reason a simple love for one little dog slowly became a lifelong journey.
quote:
The name Kingdom of Snowstorm was born from the special world I share with my Bichons. They are my little kingdom, the ones who made this name come to life. Their presence, their character and the way they fill my days are the true meaning behind this name. 
Like a snowstorm, they bring movement, energy and a special feeling that cannot be described, making every moment with them unforgettable.
Everything began with Hannah, but Kingdom of Snowstorm belongs to all of them. 
Each one is a part of this journey, and together they are the heart of the story behind this name.
